Subject: Interested in Hosted API eval for PLG use case

Hi Tessa,

I signed up for a Hosted API trial earlier this morning and wanted to follow up directly. We're ParcelFlow (logistics routing + customer messaging). Our ML team is looking at Redwood's Hosted API to evaluate latency and cost for a short proof-of-concept: 1) reranking candidate message templates, 2) embeddings for intent grouping, and 3) a low-latency generate use case for quick SMS responses.

Would love a 30-minute walkthrough/demo focused on the Hosted API quickstart and performance characteristics. We're flexible this week but prefer mornings PST.

I attached a small set of sample payloads to give context (sample_payloads.json). Attendees: me (Head of ML) and Michael Chen (Engineering).

Thanks —
